fields.description: 350 Riverside Crescent is an apartment tower in Sobha Hartland 2, Dubai. Its compact one-bedroom homes sit alongside study-equipped layouts and larger two-bedroom apartments. The original plan pack contains several variants whose balcony size and room configuration differ substantially.

overview: A study layout is marketed as 1.5 bedrooms. The large Type F drawing also carries that label, so its second enclosed room has not been silently reclassified as a standard bedroom.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Hartland 2 in Dubai. The official page names Mohammed Bin Rashid City; individual skyline and lagoon views depend on unit position.
research.priceNote: The current official guide is AED 2.50m subject to inventory. Property Finder retains a historical AED 1.5m launch reference. A broker lists a different selected one-bedroom collection; these are not interchangeable quotations.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% booking, 60% construction and 20% handover. KMJ instead advertises 20/40/40 for its selected collection. No current primary unit calendar was found; no hybrid plan is inferred.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives March 2027, while KMJ reports Q4 2027. The shared year 2027 is displayed with a timing qualifier; the quarter needs a current contractual document.
